summary: PayPal sandbox integration tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest passing (config, quote small/medium with live FX rate ~3.408, create-order returns real sandbox order_id, capture of unapproved order returns controlled 400, admin settings paypal_client_id/paypal_secret_masked/paypal_mode all correct, secret preserved on save without touching it, mode toggle sandbox↔live works). Frontend: PaymentDialog opens from open-payment-dialog-btn, plans update total (small USD 322.80, medium USD 616.25), PayPal iframe renders correctly. Admin Configuración tab shows PayPal card with all 3 fields (client_id populated, secret masked placeholder 'Actual: EEY5m7_6FoJf…Z4Ko', mode select=sandbox), saving without secret preserves the mask. Regressions: audit stays in pendiente_pago, /audits/{id}/analyze returns 402 for unpaid, banner+button flow works. Guest-checkout via 'Debit or Credit Card' in Playwright triggers PayPal's secure-card browser popup that requires re-launch (browser automation limitation, NOT a code bug per spec).
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentDialog.jsx: PayPalScriptProvider re-creates on every render because options object is inline; consider useMemo to avoid SDK reloads when quote updates (currently mitigated by forceReRender on PayPalButtons).
routes/payments.py get_pen_usd_rate: no rate-limit/error handling if open.er-api.com quota exceeded; falls back to cached rate only if cache exists — OK but consider surfacing stale-cache warning.
admin.py PUT /settings does not validate paypal_mode enum (accepts arbitrary strings); low risk since UI is a select, but backend should enforce ('sandbox','live').

success_rate.frontend: 100% (E2E card capture not completable due to PayPal popup limitation)

seed_data_creation: None. Existing audit 6a57731f1ba8274ddfe93fd6 used. A new db.payments record was created by test_create_order_success (status=created, not captured); main agent may want to clean it up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PayPal sandbox E2E capture via automated guest-card checkout is not feasible: clicking 'Debit or Credit Card' inside the smart-buttons iframe launches PayPal's card-fields secure browser popup which requires user re-launch action. To test full capture flow you would need PayPal sandbox buyer credentials or manual browser interaction. All observable code paths (config/quote/create-order/capture-unapproved/admin settings) verified working.
